$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers for THIS repo. Pins `omnigraph` to the `great-wiki` graph.
ONE omnigraph server per repo: a bridge serves exactly one graph, chosen by
OMNIGRAPH_GRAPH_ID, and no tool takes a graph argument. Never write this repo's data
to the shared `memory` graph -- that one holds global Preferences only.
APPROVAL GATE: a tracked .mcp.json cannot approve itself. Without
`.claude/settings.local.json` -> {"enabledMcpjsonServers": ["omnigraph"]} the tool is
ABSENT ENTIRELY -- no prompt, no error. That file is untracked by design.
PRECEDENCE: keep repo-bound servers OUT of user scope (~/.claude.json). A same-named
user-scope server silently overrides this file and answers about the WRONG graph.
Inspect both scopes:
python -c "import json,pathlib;d=json.loads((pathlib.Path.home()/'.claude.json').read_text());print('user:',sorted(d.get('mcpServers') or {}))"
SERVER-SIDE PREREQUISITE: the graph does not exist just because this file names it.
cd ~/code/agent-skills/infra/mcp-servers
./scripts/add-project-graph.sh great-wiki && ./scripts/apply-cluster.sh
GRAPHIFY is deliberately NOT declared here. graphify.serve is stdio and inherits its
launch directory, so ONE cwd-relative entry in USER scope serves every repo. A per-repo
entry is the old bug (one repo's graph answering for all). What opts this repo in is
having built `graphify-out/graph.json`, not an entry here. Verify:
bash ~/code/agent-skills/infra/mcp-servers/scripts/linux/check-graphify-scope.sh --fix
SERENA is configured by .serena/project.yml, not here.
ENV (never hardcode -- this file is tracked and the repo is PUBLIC):
OMNIGRAPH_TOKEN unset -> empty bearer -> 'missing bearer token' (memory silently dead)
OMNIGRAPH_NET wrong   -> 'fetch failed' (a network can EXIST but be EMPTY). Differs per
host: mcp-server_mcp-net local, mcp-servers_default central.
image not built       -> 'pull access denied':
docker build -t omnigraph-mcp:latest ~/code/agent-skills/infra/mcp-servers/servers/omnigraph-mcp
Diagnose all four: ~/code/agent-skills/infra/mcp-servers/omnigraph-setup/setup-agent-memory.sh --check
Transport is docker, not npx: node/npx is absent on coding.vm.
Router: ~/code/agent-skills/skills/repository-index/SKILL.md
Memory: ~/code/agent-skills/skills/structured-memory/SKILL.md
